criteria.silhouette_scale: A low broad workbench supports an open upright loom frame, producing a wide artisan-workshop silhouette within the 3x3 envelope.
criteria.implementable_geometry: The thin bench, eighth-block feet, quarter-beam uprights and crossbar fit the existing cut-block system; the single roller remains the existing copper construction part.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: The roller spans between two supported uprights with a large open center and no interfering decorative mechanism.
criteria.period_materials: Warm oak, one copper roller and a pale woven controller insert suit organized late-nineteenth-century textile work without generic steampunk ornament.
criteria.family_consistency: The assembly uses the Smithy's partial-block craft language while remaining lighter, wider and less masonry-heavy than the Tannery.
criteria.controls_readability: The front-center controller is integrated into the bench and the woven swatch supplies immediate textile identity.
criteria.gameplay_scope: The design changes only structure geometry and artwork; it adds no separate cloth block, powered loom mechanism or recipe behavior.
